preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is at most 40.
The input string S contains exactly one '@' character, indicating it is an email address.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() or c in {'+', '-', '(', ')', ' '} for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only valid characters for email addresses or phone numbers.

postconditions.expression: return_value.islower() if '@' in S else True
postconditions.description: If the input is an email address, the output is in lowercase.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('l*****e@') if '@' in S and len(S.split('@')[0]) == 5 else True
postconditions.description: For email addresses, the first name is masked correctly with 5 asterisks between the first and last letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('+**-') if len(digits) == 12 else (return_value.startswith('***-') if len(digits) == 10 else True)
postconditions.description: The phone number is masked correctly based on the number of digits, exposing the last 4 digits and masking the rest.
The last 4 digits of the phone number are correctly exposed in the output.
